title: Random BT disconnects with Omnipod Dash on A15
body:
I am experiencing random disconnects (I am aware of _Preferences-->Bond BT Device on A15+_ setting but enabling/disabling it does not bring the connection back) that don't seem to exhibit any pattern.  Only solution is to hamburger menu -> Exit AAPS to bring connection back.

The latest disconnection on my Samsung Galaxy S23U (SM-S918U) daily driver is shown below from the _Overview_ screen:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/aca99dfc-e9ed-4c2d-9869-a4058728ce8e)

Timeout duration from _Dash_ screen:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8e9eaa26-9cf7-4f23-a08f-0b9a2a30582f),

Here are the particulars of my build and NS information:

AAPS 3.3.2.0
Build: ba551caffc-2025.04.04
Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS.git
Flavor: fullrelease
Nightscout version: 15.0.2

I am attaching logs to this report as well:

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1750853249273.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20905649/AndroidAPS_LOG_1750853249273.log.zip)

This appeared with Android 15 upgrade and not sure if this Bluetooth issue will persist on upcoming Android 16.

comments.body:
This is a known issue and there is already a mega thread here: #3471 

There is a lot of information in there, but to summarize, there is no fix for the issue. If the bond option doesn't work for you then there is no current solution. Based on your other issue that you opened, I suggest you try the bond option but you need to accept the pairing request. Then reboot the phone and see if the problem persists.

Understood.  Rebooting after accepting pairing restore communication, I'll got ahead and close this.  I'll reference the mega thread entry to troubleshoot my disconnect issues in #4048 and close if related to it.  Thank you so much @nickb24 🙏
